messages:
nina: Quick preflight — dropping the draft RN snippet and the deploy-bot schedule. Need: release-note signoff, model/service pin confirmations, and who is covering the change window. Deploy bot is scheduled for Mon 2026-03-22 04:00 UTC (04:00-05:00 UTC).

nina: RELEASE NOTES DRAFT:
```
- api-server: bump 2.13.9 -> 2.14.0-rc3 (performance fixes, telemetry opt-in)
- kv-cache: enable prefix_caching by default (opt-out via env)
- model: gptx-1b-quant v1.2 (quantized) pinned for standard tier; fallback: gptx-1b-legacy
- infra: driver/kernel selector improvements for nvlink farms
- console: per-route latency chart added to RN dashboard

Known issues:
- small increase in cold-starts for long-seq jobs (tracked, mitigations in place)
- staging canary shows 0.3% inference error rate on a narrow prompt set (investigating)
```

nina: PINNING NOTES:
- api-server pinned to `2.14.0-rc3` in deployment config.
- model route `gptx-standard` pinned to `gptx-1b-quant:v1.2` and will not auto-upgrade during rollout.
- If rollback needed, command is: `./infra/deploy rollback --service api-server --to 2.13.9`

ryan: LGTM on RN wording. Confirming DB migration is additive and gated behind feature-flag. :+1:

maya: small ops ask — canary plan: 5% traffic for 15m then 25% for 15m then 100% if green. Add smoke test step after 25% ramp. Also add a short CLI snippet for rollback in RN.

ajay: I can cover the window. I'll run the smoke-suite and watch token-level latencies. Please add me to the deployment thread when bot starts.

carlos: Where's the rollback runbook? Putting link here: https://internal.docs/runbooks/rollback (please verify access). If we need force-cut, we use: `infra/traffic-cut --route gptx-standard --target gptx-1b-legacy` and alert #incidents.

jen: Suggest minor phrasing: change "telemetry opt-in" -> "telemetry: opt-in enabled; user consent required". Also we should notify sales/support a day ahead — I can draft the customer-facing snippet after we lock RN.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy event created by @nina.
- target: production
- window: 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z - 2026-03-22T05:00:00Z
- canary: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> 100%
- auto-rollback: enabled (triggers on 5% error rate delta or latency SLO breach)
- pinned variants: api-server=2.14.0-rc3, gptx-standard=gptx-1b-quant:v1.2

deploy-bot: Note — if auto-rollback triggers, bot will: 1) cut traffic to pinned fallback, 2) open rollback incident, 3) post summary to #incidents and ping @oncall.

nina: Thanks — @ajay you're the primary oncall, @ryan backup. @jen please draft the external blurb after we confirm pinning. I'll lock the RN by EOD and update the deploy-bot schedule if anything changes.

maya: Added a short smoke test checklist in the thread for reference:
```
- health check on /health (200)
- sample inference: 5 short prompts -> verify stable latency < 200ms median
- kv-cache hit-rate sanity (> 5%)
- verify model identity header: X-Model: gptx-1b-quant:v1.2
```

ajay: Got it, will run those and paste results.

nina: final ask — if anyone sees anything else that must be in RN (comms, rollbacks, legal flags), drop it now. Otherwise locking in 04:00 UTC window. :lock:
